  before={"---\nname: architect\ndescription: Decomposes high-level goals into granular, verifiable tasks. Use when starting a new feature, when a task feels too complex to implement in one go, or when you need a clear roadmap for execution.\n---\n\n# Architect Skill\n\n## Goal\nTo decompose a high-level goal into independent, verifiable sub-tasks, establishing the plan of attack for the Executor workflows.\n\n## Quick Start\n1. **Health Check**: Run \\`python seikoclaw.py doctor\\` to ensure the environment and dependencies are ready.\n2. **Discovery**: Use \\`list_dir\\`, \\`grep_search\\`, and read relevant Knowledge Items (KIs) to understand the project state.\n3. **Decomposition**: Break the goal into discrete execution blocks (1-2 edits + 1 verification run).\n4. **Plan**: Write tasks to \\`task.md\\` using the standard \\`[ ]\\` checkbox format.\n\n## Workflows\n\n### Task Decomposition\nWhen breaking down a task, ensure every item has:\n- A specific **Objective** (what is being changed).\n- A specific **Test/Verification** (how to prove it works).\n- Consult \\`skills/third-party/planning-and-task-breakdown/SKILL.md\\` for sizing rules.\n\n## Checklists\n- [ ] High-level requirements are fully understood.\n- [ ] Task list is written to \\`task.md\\`.\n- [ ] No single task touches more than 5 files.\n- [ ] Every task has a corresponding test command.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n- **The \"Big Bang\" Task**: Creating a single task for a complex feature without sub-steps.\n- **Vague Verification**: Using \"Check if it works\" instead of a specific command like \\`pytest\\`.\n- **Ignoring KIs**: Implementing a pattern that contradicts an existing Knowledge Item.\n\n## Handoff\nOnce the task blueprint is set, notify the user or transition to \\`executor\\` for the first uncompleted task."}

Decomposition\nWhen breaking down a task, ensure every item has:\n- A specific **Objective** (what is being changed).\n- A specific **Test/Verification** (how to prove it works).\n- Consult \\`skills/third-party/planning-and-task-breakdown/SKILL.md\\` for sizing rules.\n\n## Checklists\n- [ ] High-level requirements are fully understood.\n- [ ] Known mistakes & gotchas checked in   before={"---\ndescription: \"Architect Workflow: Breaks down broad project directives into granular task checklists.\"\n---\n\n# Architect Workflow\n\n## Goal\nTo decompose a high-level goal into independent, verifiable sub-tasks, establishing the plan of attack for the Executor workflows.\n\n## Prerequisites\n- A clear high-level user request (e.g., \"Add Karate tests for Tablebuddy\").\n\n## Steps\n\n0. **Context Recall & Instant Gut-Check**\n   Before planning, check if this is a new feature or build request.\n   - If proposing a new build/feature, trigger \\`/before-building\\` to surface 1\u20133 consequential choices first.\n   - Query Openbrain to identify similar past tasks, implementation patterns, or relevant engineering skills:\n     \\`python seikoclaw.py memory --query \"[concise task description]\"\\`\n\n1. **Project & Source Discovery**\n   Perform deep discovery of the active codebase. Use \\`view_file\\`, \\`list_dir\\`, \\`grep_search\\`, and review the recalled memories to understand the existing project structure and capabilities.\n\n2. **Decompose the Goal**\n   Break the project directive down into discrete execution blocks using the 5-part goal contract from \\`seikoclaw-goal-prompter\\` (Objective, Read First, Constraints, Validate, Document, Stop Condition). A good block should take no more than 1-2 code edits and a single verification run.\n\n3. **Token Budget Assessment**\n   Estimate the \"output weight\" of the plan. \n   - Rule: If the planned response (report + task list + code previews) is likely to exceed ~32,000 tokens, pause and ask the user to proceed with the first half.\n   - Action: \\`python d:\\DevWorkspace\\SeikoClaw\\token_estimator.py \"[draft content snippet]\"\\`\n\n4. **Generate and Serve Visual Plan**\n   - If we are working in Planning Mode, write the blocks to \\`<appDataDir>\\brain\\<conversation-id>/task.md\\`.\n   - Run the visual plan subcommand: \\`python seikoclaw.py plan --task task.md\\`\n   - This parses \\`task.md\\` and generates a structured visual plan in \\`.agents/plans/plan/plan.mdx\\`, then starts the local bridge server using \\`npx @agent-native/core\\`.\n   - Review the served bridge URL to verify syntax and wireframe layouts.\n\n5. **Yield or Pass to Executor**\n   Once the visual plan is served and approved by the user, transition to the \\`executor.md\\` workflow for the first uncompleted task. \n   *Note: If the transition itself will push the response over the token limit, stop after generating task.md and serving the plan.*"}
  after={"---\ndescription: \"Architect Workflow: Breaks down broad project directives into granular task checklists.\"\n---\n\n# Architect Workflow\n\n## Goal\nTo decompose a high-level goal into independent, verifiable sub-tasks, establishing the plan of attack for the Executor workflows.\n\n## Prerequisites\n- A clear high-level user request (e.g., \"Add Karate tests for Tablebuddy\").\n\n## Steps\n\n0. **Context Recall, Mistake Check & Instant Gut-Check**\n   Before planning, check if this is a new feature or build request.\n   - If proposing a new build/feature, trigger \\`/before-building\\` to surface 1\u20133 consequential choices first.\n   - Query Openbrain for past tasks, skills, and **known mistakes/pitfalls**:\n     \\`python seikoclaw.py memory --query \"[task description] mistakes pitfalls gotchas\"\\`\n\n1. **Project & Source Discovery**\n   Perform deep discovery of the active codebase. Use \\`view_file\\`, \\`list_dir\\`, \\`grep_search\\`, and review the recalled memories to understand the existing project structure and capabilities.\n\n2. **Decompose the Goal**\n   Break the project directive down into discrete execution blocks using the 5-part goal contract from \\`seikoclaw-goal-prompter\\` (Objective, Read First, Constraints, Validate, Document, Stop Condition). A good block should take no more than 1-2 code edits and a single verification run.\n\n3. **Mandatory Task List (\\`task.md\\`) Generation**\n   - **Rule**: Every implementation plan MUST output a concrete \\`task.md\\` checklist with verifiable checkboxes (\\`- [ ]\\`) and test commands before proceeding to execution.\n   - Write the checklist to \\`task.md\\` (or \\`<appDataDir>\\brain\\<conversation-id>/task.md\\`).\n   - This task list acts as the deterministic trigger for the **Automated Post-Task Reflection Hook** (\\`auto_capture.py\\` / \\`seikoclaw reflect\\`) upon completion.\n\n4. **Token Budget Assessment & Visual Plan**\n   - Estimate output weight using \\`token_estimator.py\\`.\n   - Run visual plan subcommand if needed: \\`python seikoclaw.py plan --task task.md\\`\n   - This generates \\`.agents/plans/plan/plan.mdx\\` and serves the local bridge.\n\n5. **Yield or Pass to Executor**\n   Once \\`task.md\\` is generated and approved by the user, transition to the \\`executor.md\\` workflow for the first uncompleted task.\n"}

  before={"import os\nimport sys\nimport json\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# Add local path to sys.path to allow importing openbrain\nsys.path.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))\n\nfrom openbrain.memory_engine import MemoryEngine\nfrom openbrain.usage_monitor import UsageMonitor\n\nclass AutoCapture:\n    def __init__(self):\n        # Resolve DB path local-first with global fallback\n        cwd_openbrain = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), \"openbrain\")\n        if os.path.isdir(cwd_openbrain):\n            db_path = os.path.join(cwd_openbrain, \"openbrain.db\")\n            chroma_path = os.path.join(cwd_openbrain, \"chroma_db\")\n        else:\n            global_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(\"~\"), \".gemini\", \"antigravity\", \"openbrain\")\n            os.makedirs(global_dir, exist_ok=True)\n            db_path = os.path.join(global_dir, \"openbrain.db\")\n            chroma_path = os.path.join(global_dir, \"chroma_db\")\n            \n        print(f\"[AutoCapture] Using Database: {db_path}\")\n        self.memory = MemoryEngine(db_path, chroma_path)\n        self.usage = UsageMonitor(db_path)\n\n    def find_recent_task_md(self):\n        # 1. Check local directory first\n        for p in [\"task.md\", \"artifact/task.md\"]:\n            if os.path.exists(p):\n                return p\n        # 2. Check global brain folders for the most recently modified task.md\n        brain_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(\"~\"), \".gemini\", \"antigravity\", \"brain\")\n        if os.path.exists(brain_dir):\n            task_files = []\n            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(brain_dir):\n                if \"task.md\" in files:\n                    p = os.path.join(root, \"task.md\")\n                    try:\n                        mtime = os.path.getmtime(p)\n                        task_files.append((p, mtime))\n                    except Exception:\n                        pass\n            if task_files:\n                task_files.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\n                return task_files[0][0]\n        return None\n\n    def capture_session(self):\n        print(\"[AutoCapture] Evaluating session state...\")\n        \n        # 1. Read task.md for progress\n        progress = \"No recent task info found.\"\n        task_md_path = self.find_recent_task_md()\n        if task_md_path and os.path.exists(task_md_path):\n            print(f\"[AutoCapture] Reading tasks from: {task_md_path}\")\n            with open(task_md_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                progress = f.read()\n        \n        # 2. Get Usage Metrics\n        google_usage = self.usage.get_todays_usage(\"google\")\n        usage_str = f\"Usage today: {google_usage['tokens']} tokens.\"\n        \n        # 3. Summarize\n        project_name = os.path.basename(os.getcwd())\n        summary = f\"Session Capture ({project_name}): Successfully completed tasks. {usage_str} Progress:\\n{progress[:2000]}\"\n        \n        # 4. Save to memory\n        mem_id = self.memory.save_memory(summary, tier=\"Shortterm\", source=\"auto-capture\")\n        print(f\"[AutoCapture] Saved session summary: {mem_id}\")\n        \n        # 5. Extract skills (Mocking for now)\n        skill_text = \"Skill Learned: Implemented dynamic database path resolution for global agent operations.\"\n        self.memory.save_memory(skill_text, tier=\"Midterm\", source=\"auto-capture\", tags=\"skill\")\n        print(\"[AutoCapture] Captured new skills.\")\n\n        # 6. Trigger Visual Recap\n        try:\n            from seikoclaw import SeikoClaw\n            claw = SeikoClaw()\n            recap_url = claw.generate_visual_recap(project_name)\n            if recap_url:\n                self.memory.save_memory(f\"Visual Recap URL: {recap_url}\", tier=\"Shortterm\", source=\"auto-capture\", tags=\"recap,visual\")\n                print(f\"[AutoCapture] Saved Visual Recap URL to Openbrain: {recap_url}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"[AutoCapture Warning] Visual recap generation failed: {e}\")\n\ndef main():\n    ac = AutoCapture()\n    ac.capture_session()\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()"}

UNIQUE (id)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS databases (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- unique globally\n    name TEXT NOT NULL, -- unique per tenant\n    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) globally\n    name TEXT NOT NULL, -- unique per database\n    topic TEXT NOT NULL,\n    dimension INTEGER,\n    database_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES databases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE (name, database_id)\n);\n\n-- Create default tenant and database\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO tenants (id) VALUES ('default_tenant'); -- The default tenant id is 'default_tenant' others are UUIDs\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO databases (id, name, tenant_id) VALUES ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'default_database', 'default_tenant');\n\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO collections_tmp (id, name, topic, dimension, database_id)\n    SELECT id, name, topic, dimension, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' FROM collections;\nDROP TABLE collections;\nALTER TABLE collections_tmp RENAME TO SET int_seq_id = (\n  SELECT (\n       (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -1 , 1)) <<  0)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -2 , 1)) <<  4)\n     | , 1)) << 28)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -9 , 1)) << 32)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -10, 1)) << 36)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -11, 1)) << 40)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -12, 1)) << 44)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -13, 1)) << 48)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -14, 1)) << 52)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -15, 1)) << 56)\n     | (instr('123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(seq_id), -16, 1)) << 60)\n    )\n);\n\nALTER TABLE max_seq_id DROP COLUMN seq_id;\nALTER TABLE max_seq_id RENAME COLUMN int_seq_id TO   before={"import sqlite3\nimport uuid\nfrom datetime import datetime\nimport chromadb\nfrom .context_engine import ContextEngine\n\nclass MemoryEngine:\n    def __init__(self, db_path=\"openbrain.db\", chroma_path=\"./chroma_db\"):\n        self.sqlite_path = db_path\n        self._init_sqlite()\n        self._init_chroma(chroma_path)\n        self.context_engine = ContextEngine(self)\n\n    def _get_conn(self):\n        return sqlite3.connect(self.sqlite_path)\n\n    def _init_sqlite(self):\n        \"\"\"Ensures all necessary SQLite tables exist.\"\"\"\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.sqlite_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        \n        # 1. Tiered Memories\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memories (\n                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                content TEXT NOT NULL,\n                tier TEXT CHECK(tier IN ('Core', 'Longterm', 'Midterm', 'Shortterm')) DEFAULT 'Shortterm',\n                source TEXT,\n                tags TEXT,\n                weight REAL DEFAULT 1.0,\n                last_accessed TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n            )\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # 2. Learned Skills\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skills (\n                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n                description TEXT,\n                example_usage TEXT,\n                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n            )\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # 3. Project States\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_states (\n                project_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                current_branch TEXT,\n                last_blocker TEXT,\n                next_step TEXT,\n                checkpoint_data JSON,\n                updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n            )\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # 4. Usage Statistics\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage_stats (\n                stat_date DATE DEFAULT (DATE('now')),\n                provider TEXT NOT NULL,\n                tokens_used INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n                requests_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n                PRIMARY KEY (stat_date, provider)\n            )\n        \"\"\")\n\n        # 5. Generated Assets (for ArtistAgent)\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generated_assets (\n                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                prompt TEXT,\n                style_markers TEXT,\n                bias_weight REAL,\n                seed INTEGER,\n                output_path TEXT,\n                rating INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n            )\n        \"\"\")\n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n\n    def _init_chroma(self, path):\n        self.chroma_client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=path)\n        self.collection = self.chroma_client.get_or_create_collection(name=\"openbrain_memories\")\n\n    def save_memory(self, text: str, tier: str = \"Shortterm\", source: str = \"user\", tags: str = \"\"):\n        \"\"\"Saves a memory to both SQLite (meta) and ChromaDB (vector).\"\"\"\n        mem_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        \n        # 1. Save to SQLite\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.sqlite_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            INSERT INTO memories (id, content, tier, source, tags)\n            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n        \"\"\", (mem_id, text, tier, source, tags))\n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n        \n        # 2. Save to Chroma\n        self.collection.add(\n            documents=[text],\n            metadatas=[{\"id\": mem_id, \"tier\": tier, \"source\": source, \"tags\": tags}],\n            ids=[mem_id]\n        )\n        # 3. Check for consolidation\n        if tier == \"Shortterm\":\n            # Auto-trigger compression every 10 memories (can be tuned)\n            self.context_engine.compress_shortterm(tag=tags.split(',')[0] if tags else None)\n\n        return mem_id\n\n    def retrieve_similar(self, query: str, n_results: int = 5, min_tier: str = \"Shortterm\"):\n        \"\"\"Search Chroma for similar items, filtered by tier (logic handled at app level).\"\"\"\n        results = self.collection.query(\n            query_texts=[query],\n            n_results=n_results\n        )\n        \n        if not results['documents'] or not results['documents'][0]:\n            return []\n            \n        memories = []\n        for i in range(len(results['documents'][0])):\n            memories.append({\n                \"id\": results['ids'][0][i],\n                \"content\": results['documents'][0][i],\n                \"metadata\": results['metadatas'][0][i],\n                \"distance\": results['distances'][0][i]\n            })\n        return memories\n\n    def save_asset(self, prompt, style_markers, bias_weight, seed, output_path):\n        \"\"\"Records a generated asset and its parameters.\"\"\"\n        asset_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.sqlite_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            INSERT INTO generated_assets (id, prompt, style_markers, bias_weight, seed, output_path)\n            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n        \"\"\", (asset_id, prompt, style_markers, bias_weight, seed, output_path))\n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n        return asset_id\n\n    def score_asset(self, asset_id, rating):\n        \"\"\"Updates asset rating and adjusts underlying memory weights/tiers.\"\"\"\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.sqlite_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        \n        # 1. Get style markers associated with this asset\n        cur.execute(\"SELECT style_markers FROM generated_assets WHERE id = ?\", (asset_id,))\n        row = cur.fetchone()\n        if not row:\n            conn.close()\n            return\n            \n        markers = [m.strip() for m in row[0].split(\",\") if m.strip()]\n        \n        # 3. Upsert\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            INSERT INTO project_states (project_name, checkpoint_data, updated_at)\n            VALUES (?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n            ON       \n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n\n    def get_kanban(self, project_name: str):\n        \"\"\"Retrieves the Kanban board for a project.\"\"\"\n        import json\n        conn = Version bump or refine rules based on new trajectory.\n2. Maintain existing technical exactness while adding new insights.\n\nIf no PREVIOUS_SKILL, perform a SYNTHESIS.\n\nFORMAT:\n---\nname: [Skill Name]\nevolution: Lite | Full | Ultra\nversion: [X.Y.Z]\n---\n# RULES\n[thing] [action] [result].\n# BOUNDARIES\nWhat NOT to do.\n# AUTO-CLARITY\nTechnical PIDs/Ports/Patterns.\n\nPREVIOUS_SKILL:\n{previous_skill}\n\nTRAJECTORY:\n{trajectory}\n\"\"\"\n\n# Fix for Windows terminal UTF-8 encoding issues\nif sys.stdout.encoding != 'utf-8':\n    try:\n        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')\n    except AttributeError:\n        # Fallback for older python\n        import codecs\n        sys.stdout = codecs.getwriter(\"utf-8\")(sys.stdout.detach())\n\nclass IterationBudget:\n    def __init__(self, max_turns=5, max_tokens=100000, context_limit=1000000):\n        self.max_turns = max_turns\n        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n        self.context_limit = context_limit\n        self.current_turns = 0\n        self.current_tokens = 0\n        self.estimated_context = 0\n\n    def consume(self, tokens=0, context_tokens=0):\n        self.current_turns += 1\n        self.current_tokens += tokens\n        self.estimated_context = context_tokens\n\n    def is_exhausted(self):\n        return (self.current_turns >= self.max_turns or \n                self.current_tokens >= self.max_tokens or \n                self.estimated_context >= (self.context_limit * 0.9))\n\n    def __str__(self):\n        return (f\"Budget: {self.current_turns}/{self.max_turns} turns, \"\n                f\"Session: {self.current_tokens} tokens, \"\n                f\"Context: {self.estimated_context}/{self.context_limit}\")\n\nclass SeikoClaw:\n    def __init__(self):\n        cwd_openbrain = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), \"openbrain\")\n        if os.path.isdir(cwd_openbrain):\n            db_path = os.path.join(cwd_openbrain, \"openbrain.db\")\n            chroma_path = os.path.join(cwd_openbrain, \"chroma_db\")\n        else:\n            global_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(\"~\"), \".gemini\", \"antigravity\", \"openbrain\")\n            os.makedirs(global_dir, exist_ok=True)\n            db_path = os.path.join(global_dir, \"openbrain.db\")\n            chroma_path = os.path.join(global_dir, \"chroma_db\")\n            \n        self.sqlite_path = db_path\n        self.chroma_path = chroma_path\n        self.vault = Vault(db_path)\n        self.usage = UsageMonitor(db_path)\n        self.memory = MemoryEngine(db_path, chroma_path)\n        self.gater = SkillGater()\n        \n        # Default limits\n        self.limits = {\n            \"anthropic\": {\"tokens\": 100000, \"requests\": 500},\n            \"google\": {\"tokens\": 200000, \"requests\": 1000}\n        }\n\n    def unlock_vault(self):\n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Initializing Vault...\")\n        password = os.getenv(\"SEIKOCLAW_MASTER_PASS\")\n        if not password:\n            print(\"[WARNING] SEIKOCLAW_MASTER_PASS env var not set. Some features will be locked.\")\n            return False\n        \n        self.vault.unlock(password)\n        return True\n\n    def _git_run(self, cmd):\n        result = subprocess.run(f\"git {cmd}\", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n        stdout = (result.stdout or \"\").strip()\n        stderr = (result.stderr or \"\").strip()\n        return result.returncode, stdout, stderr\n\n    def _is_git_repo(self):\n        rc, _, _ = self._git_run(\"rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree\")\n        return rc == 0\n\n    def _get_current_branch(self):\n        rc, out, _ = self._git_run(\"rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD\")\n        if rc == 0:\n            return out\n        return None\n\n    def _is_git_dirty(self):\n        rc, out, _ = self._git_run(\"status --porcelain\")\n        return rc == 0 and bool(out)\n\n    def start_sandbox(self, task_id):\n        if not self._is_git_repo():\n            print(\"[SANDBOX WARNING] Not a Git repository. Running without sandbox.\")\n            return False, None, False\n\n        original_branch = self._get_current_branch()\n        if not original_branch:\n            print(\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Could not determine current Git branch.\")\n            return False, None, False\n\n        dirty = self._is_git_dirty()\n        stashed = False\n        if dirty:\n            print(f\"[SANDBOX] Working tree is dirty. Stashing changes...\")\n            rc, _, err = self._git_run(\"stash push -m \\\"seikoclaw-pre-sandbox-stash\\\"\")\n            if rc != 0:\n                print(f\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to stash changes: {err}\")\n                return False, None, False\n            stashed = True\n\n        sandbox_branch = f\"seikoclaw-sandbox-{task_id}\"\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Creating and checking out sandbox branch: {sandbox_branch}\")\n        \n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\"checkout -b {sandbox_branch}\")\n        if rc != 0:\n            print(f\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to create sandbox branch: {err}\")\n            if stashed:\n                print(\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\")\n                self._git_run(\"stash pop\")\n            return False, None, False\n\n        return True, original_branch, stashed\n\n    def commit_and_merge_sandbox(self, task_id, original_branch, stashed):\n        sandbox_branch = f\"seikoclaw-sandbox-{task_id}\"\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Committing changes on {sandbox_branch}...\")\n        self._git_run(\"add -A\")\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\"commit -m \\\"seikoclaw: completed task {task_id}\\\"\")\n        if rc != 0:\n            print(f\"[SANDBOX WARNING] Failed to commit changes (possibly no changes made): {err}\")\n\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Returning to original branch: {original_branch}\")\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\"checkout {original_branch}\")\n        if rc != 0:\n            print(f\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to return to original branch: {err}\")\n            return False\n\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Merging sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\")\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\"merge --no-ff -m \\\"Merge branch '{sandbox_branch}'\\\" {sandbox_branch}\")\n        if rc != 0:\n            print(f\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Merge failed: {err}\")\n            return False\n\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\")\n        self._git_run(f\"branch -d {sandbox_branch}\")\n\n        if stashed:\n            print(\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\")\n            self._git_run(\"stash pop\")\n\n        return True\n\n    def discard_sandbox(self, task_id, original_branch, stashed):\n        sandbox_branch = f\"seikoclaw-sandbox-{task_id}\"\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Discarding sandbox changes on {sandbox_branch}...\")\n        \n        self._git_run(\"reset --hard\")\n        self._git_run(\"clean -fd\")\n\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Returning to original branch: {original_branch}\")\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\"checkout {original_branch}\")\n        if rc != 0:\n            print(f\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to return to original branch: {err}\")\n            return False\n\n        print(f\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\")\n        self._git_run(f\"branch -D {sandbox_branch}\")\n\n        if stashed:\n            print(\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\")\n            self._git_run(\"stash pop\")\n\n        return True\n\n    def run_task(self, name, command, cwd=None):\n        \"\"\"Executes a single command with usage oversight.\"\"\"\n        provider = \"google\" # Default for most tools here\n        \n        # 1. Check limits before starting\n        limit_reached, msg = self.usage.check_limits(\n            provider, \n            self.limits[provider][\"tokens\"], \n            self.limits[provider][\"requests\"]\n        )\n        \n        if limit_reached:\n            print(f\"[PAUSED] {name}: {msg}\")\n            return f\"SKIP: {msg}\"\n\n        print(f\"[Executing] {name}: {command} (in {cwd or '.'})\")\n        \n        # 2. Execute\n        try:\n            result = subprocess.run(command, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd)\n            \n            # 3. Estimate actual token usage of the output\n            output_text = result.stdout + result.stderr\n            actual_tokens = token_estimator.estimate_tokens(output_text)\n            \n            # 4. Track usage\n            self.usage.track_usage(provider, tokens=actual_tokens, requests=1) \n            \n            # 5. Safety Warning: If output is very large, alert for manual summarization\n            if actual_tokens > 10000:\n                print(f\"[CRITICAL] {name} output is {actual_tokens} tokens! Consider summarizing before next task.\")\n\n            if result.returncode == 0:\n                return f\"SUCCESS: {name}\"\n            else:\n                return f\"FAILURE: {name}\\nError: {result.stderr}\"\n        except Exception as e:\n            return f\"ERROR: {name}\\nException: {str(e)}\"\n\n    def execute_tablebuddy_tests(self):\n        \"\"\"Orchestrates Tablebuddy Phase 11 testing.\"\"\"\n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Starting Tablebuddy Backend...\")\n        # Start server in background\n        server = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, \"server.py\"], cwd=\"d:/DevWorkspace/Tablebuddy\")\n        import time\n        time.sleep(3) # Wait for startup\n        \n        try:\n            tasks = [\n                {\"name\": \"Auth & Roles\", \"command\": \"java -cp \\\"../karate.jar;.\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/auth_and_roles.feature\"},\n                {\"name\": \"Asset Management\", \"command\": \"java -cp \\\"../karate.jar;.\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/asset_management.feature\"},\n                {\"name\": \"WebSocket Sync\", \"command\": \"java -cp \\\"../karate.jar;.\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/websocket_sync.feature\"},\n                {\"name\": \"Network Validation\", \"command\": \"java -cp \\\"../karate.jar;.\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/network_validation.feature\"}\n            ]\n            self.execute_parallel(tasks, cwd=\"d:/DevWorkspace/Tablebuddy/karate_e2e_tests\")\n        finally:\n            print(\"[SeikoClaw] Shutting down Tablebuddy Backend...\")\n            server.terminate()\n\n    def execute_parallel(self, tasks, cwd=None):\n        \"\"\"Runs multiple tasks in parallel using a thread pool.\"\"\"\n        print(f\"[SeikoClaw] Launching {len(tasks)} tasks in parallel...\")\n        \n        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:\n            fut_to_task = {executor.submit(self.run_task, t['name'], t['command'], cwd): t for t in tasks}\n            for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(fut_to_task):\n                res = future.result()\n                print(f\"[Completed] {res}\")\n\n    def sync_global(self):\n        \"\"\"Syncs local .agents and third-party skills to global locations.\"\"\"\n        import shutil\n        user_home = os.path.expanduser(\"~\")\n        global_root = os.path.join(user_home, \".gemini\", \"antigravity\")\n        \n        mapping = {\n            \".agents/workflows\": os.path.join(global_root, \"global_workflows\"),\n            \".agents/skills\": os.path.join(global_root, \"global_skills\"),\n            \".agents/modular_skills\": os.path.join(global_root, \"skills\")\n        }\n        \n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Starting Global Sync...\")\n        # 1. Sync custom assets\n        for local_dir, global_dir in mapping.items():\n            if not os.path.exists(local_dir):\n                continue\n            os.makedirs(global_dir, exist_ok=True)\n            for item in os.listdir(local_dir):\n                s = os.path.join(local_dir, item)\n                d = os.path.join(global_dir, item)\n                if os.path.isdir(s):\n                    if os.path.exists(d):\n                        shutil.rmtree(d)\n                    shutil.copytree(s, d)\n                    print(f\"[COPIED-DIR] {item} -> {global_dir}\")\n                elif os.path.isfile(s):\n                    shutil.copy2(s, d)\n                    print(f\"[COPIED-FILE] {item} -> {global_dir}\")\n        \n        # 2. Sync Third-Party Agent Skills (Preserving directory structure)\n        tp_skills_root = \"third-party/agent-skills/skills\"\n        global_skills_dest = os.path.join(global_root, \"skills\", \"third-party\")\n        if os.path.exists(tp_skills_root):\n            print(\"[SeikoClaw] Syncing Third-Party Skills (Modular)...\")\n            os.makedirs(global_skills_dest, exist_ok=True)\n            for skill_name in os.listdir(tp_skills_root):\n                skill_dir = os.path.join(tp_skills_root, skill_name)\n                if os.path.isdir(skill_dir):\n                    dest_dir = os.path.join(global_skills_dest, skill_name)\n                    if os.path.exists(dest_dir):\n                        shutil.rmtree(dest_dir)\n                    shutil.copytree(skill_dir, dest_dir)\n                    print(f\"[SYNCED-DIR] {skill_name} -> {global_skills_dest}\")\n\n    def reflect_on_task(self, task_file: str):\n        \"\"\"Analyzes a task file and synthesizes or evolves a skill.\"\"\"\n        if not os.path.exists(task_file):\n            return \"Error: Task file not found.\"\n\n        with open(task_file, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            content = f.read()\n\n        if \"[x]\" not in content:\n            return \"No completed tasks found to reflect upon.\"\n\n        print(f\"[SeikoClaw] Reflecting on completed tasks in {os.path.basename(task_file)}...\")\n        \n        # 1. Synthesis via LocalMind\n        try:\n            from localmind.engine import LocalMindEngine\n            model_dir = \"d:/DevWorkspace/BookIngestion/models\"\n            llm = LocalMindEngine(backend=\"auto\", model_dir=model_dir)\n            \n            import re\n            skill_name_candidate = None\n            match = re.search(r\"Skill:\\s*(.*)\", content)\n            if match:\n                skill_name_candidate = match.group(1).strip()\n            \n            previous_skill_text = \"None\"\n            if skill_name_candidate:\n                prev = self.memory.get_skill(skill_name_candidate)\n                if prev:\n                    previous_skill_text = str(prev)\n            \n            prompt = SKILL_SYNTHESIS_PROMPT.format(trajectory=content, previous_skill=previous_skill_text)\n            skill_text = llm.generate(prompt, max_tokens=1024)\n            \n            if skill_text and \"[Mock Response]\" not in skill_text:\n                # 2. Extract Skill Name\n                name_match = re.search(r\"name:\\s*(.*)\", skill_text)\n                skill_name = name_match.group(1).strip() if name_match else \"New Skill\"\n                \n                # 3. Gating check before saving (Validation & Regression)\n                passed, gate_msg = self.gater.gate_and_save(\n                    skill_text=skill_text,\n                    skill_name=skill_name,\n                    memory_engine=self.memory,\n                    target_dir=\".agents/skills\",\n                    previous_skill_text=previous_skill_text if previous_skill_text != \"None\" else None\n                )\n                \n                if passed:\n                    print(f\"[SUCCESS] { 'Evolved' if previous_skill_text != 'None' else 'Synthesized' } and gated skill: {skill_name}\")\n                    self.sync_wiki(f\"Auto-evolved skill: {skill_name}\")\n                    return skill_name\n                else:\n                    print(f\"[GATING FAILED] {gate_msg}\")\n                    return None\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"[ERROR] Skill reflection failed: {e}\")\n            return None\n\n    def gate_skill(self, skill_target: str):\n        \"\"\"Runs validation and regression tests against a skill file or registered skill.\"\"\"\n        print(f\"[SeikoClaw] Gating skill: {skill_target}...\")\n        skill_text = \"\"\n        if os.path.exists(skill_target):\n            with open(skill_target, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                skill_text = f.read()\n        else:\n            # Check Openbrain\n            skill_record = self.memory.get_skill(skill_target)\n            if skill_record and skill_record.get(\"example\"):\n                skill_text = skill_record[\"example\"]\n            else:\n                # Check .agents/skills/<skill_target>/SKILL.md\n                candidate_path = os.path.join(\".agents\", \"skills\", skill_target, \"SKILL.md\")\n                if os.path.exists(candidate_path):\n                    with open(candidate_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                        skill_text = f.read()\n\n        if not skill_text:\n            print(f\"[ERROR] Could not resolve skill content for: {skill_target}\")\n            return False\n\n        passed, reason = self.gater.evaluate_regression(skill_text)\n        if passed:\n            print(f\"[GATE PASS] Skill '{skill_target}' passed all validation and regression checks.\")\n            return True\n        else:\n            print(f\"[GATE FAIL] Skill '{skill_target}' failed gating:\\n  Reason: {reason}\")\n            return False\n\n    def sync_wiki(self, message=\"Auto-sync from SeikoClaw\"):\n        \"\"\"Syncs the current project state into the Master Wiki.\"\"\"\n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Syncing state to Master Wiki...\")\n        wiki_dir = \"d:/DevWorkspace/.master_wiki\"\n        if not os.path.exists(wiki_dir):\n            print(f\"[ERROR] Master Wiki not found at {wiki_dir}\")\n            return\n            \n        # 1. Read task.md for progress\n        progress = \"No recent task info found.\"\n        task_paths = [\"task.md\", \"artifact/task.md\"]\n        for p in task_paths:\n            if os.path.exists(p):\n                with open(p, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                    progress = f.read()\n                break\n                \n        # 2. Prepare payload for llmwiki-cli\n        page_data = {\n            \"title\": \"Latest Task Sync\",\n            \"tags\": [\"auto-sync\", \"seikoclaw\"],\n            \"content\": f\"## Recent Progress\\n\\n\\`\\`\\`markdown\\n{progress[:2000]}\\n\\`\\`\\`\"\n        }\n        json_input = json.dumps(page_data)\n        \n        # 3. Write to wiki using CLI\n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Writing to wiki via llmwiki-cli...\")\n        try:\n            proc = subprocess.Popen([\"wiki\", \"write\", \"wiki/synthesis/latest_sync.md\"], \n                                   cwd=wiki_dir, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, \n                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, shell=True)\n            out, err = proc.communicate(input=json_input)\n            if proc.returncode != 0:\n                print(f\"[WARNING] Wiki write failed: {err}\")\n                \n            # 4. Auto-commit with descriptive message for rollback\n            subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", \".\"], cwd=wiki_dir, shell=True)\n            subprocess.run([\"git\", \"commit\", \"-m\", f\"Auto-sync: {message}\"], cwd=wiki_dir, shell=True)\n            print(\"[SUCCESS] Master Wiki updated and committed.\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"[ERROR] Failed to sync wiki: {e}\")\n\n    def manage_kanban(self, action, task_id=None, status=None, project=\"default\"):\n        \"\"\"CLI helper for Kanban operations.\"\"\"\n        if action == \"list\":\n            board = self.memory.get_kanban(project)\n            print(f\"--- Kanban Board: {project} ---\")\n            if not board:\n                print(\"No tasks found.\")\n            for tid, info in board.items():\n                print(f\"[{info['status']}] {tid} (Updated: {info['updated_at']})\")\n        elif action == \"update\" and task_id and status:\n            self.memory.update_kanban(project, task_id, status)\n            print(f\"[SUCCESS] Updated {task_id} to {status}\")\n\n    def loop_until_goal(self, goal, max_turns=5):\n        \"\"\"Autonomous loop that continues until a goal is met or budget is exhausted.\"\"\"\n        budget = IterationBudget(max_turns=max_turns)\n        print(f\"[SeikoClaw] Starting autonomous loop for goal: {goal}\")\n        \n        while not budget.is_exhausted():\n            print(f\"\\n--- Turn {budget.current_turns + 1} ---\")\n            \n            # 1. Estimate current context\n            # We estimate by summing up Shortterm memories + recent task info\n            memories = self.memory.retrieve_similar(goal, n_results=20)\n            context_text = \"\\n\".join([m['content'] for m in memories])\n            current_context_tokens = token_estimator.estimate_tokens(context_text)\n            \n            budget.consume(tokens=0, context_tokens=current_context_tokens)\n            print(f\"[STATUS] {budget}\")\n            \n            # 2. Check for early break / handoff\n            if current_context_tokens >= (budget.context_limit * 0.9):\n                print(f\"[CRITICAL] Context limit reached ({current_context_tokens} tokens).\")\n                print(\"[ACTION] Performing auto-handoff...\")\n                handoff_path = \"handoff.md\"\n                with open(handoff_path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                    f.write(f\"# Handoff: {goal}\\n\\nLoop paused due to context pressure.\\n\")\n                    f.write(f\"Tokens: {current_context_tokens}\\n\")\n                    f.write(f\"Last Action: Loop Turn {budget.current_turns}\\n\")\n                print(f\"[ALERT] Handoff created at {handoff_path}. Please start a new session.\")\n                break\n\n            # 3. Check goal (mock check)\n            if \"complete\" in goal.lower():\n                print(\"[SUCCESS] Goal detected as complete.\")\n                break\n                \n            # 4. Memory Compression (Maintenance)\n            if self.memory.context_engine.compress_shortterm(threshold=5):\n                print(\"[MAINTENANCE] Compressed recent short-term memories into Midterm.\")\n\n            # 5. Simulate a task implementation step\n            print(\"[ACTION] Implementing next step...\")\n            \n        if budget.is_exhausted() and current_context_tokens < (budget.context_limit * 0.9):\n            print(\"[PAUSED] Iteration budget exhausted.\")\n\n        # Post-Task Reflection Hook: Trigger auto-reflection if task.md exists\n        for p in [\"task.md\", \"artifact/task.md\"]:\n            if os.path.exists(p):\n                print(\"[AUTO-HOOK] Triggering Post-Task Reflection Hook...\")\n                self.reflect_on_task(p)\n                self.sync_wiki(f\"Auto-sync after loop for goal: {goal}\")\n                break\n\n    def generate_visual_plan(self, task_file=\"task.md\"):\n        \"\"\"Generates a visual plan from a task file or master vision and serves the local bridge.\"\"\"\n        import re\n        import json\n        print(f\"[SeikoClaw] Generating Visual Plan from {task_file}...\")\n        \n        # 1. Resolve content\n        content = \"\"\n        if os.path.exists(task_file):\n            with open(task_file, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                content = f.read()\n        else:\n            # Fallback to project_vision.md\n            vision_path = \"project_vision.md\"\n            if os.path.exists(vision_path):\n                with open(vision_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                    content = f.read()\n            else:\n                content = \"No task file found.\"\n\n        # 2. Setup directory\n        plan_dir = os.path.join(\".agents\", \"plans\", \"plan\")\n        os.makedirs(plan_dir, exist_ok=True)\n        \n        # 3. Serve the bridge\n        npm_global_bin = \"D:/DevWorkspace/.npm-global/agent-native.cmd\"\n        cmd_prefix = npm_global_bin if os.path.exists(npm_global_bin) else \"npx @agent-native/core\"\n\n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Checking visual plan syntax...\")\n        subprocess.run(f\"{cmd_prefix} plan local check --dir .agents/plans/plan\", shell=True)\n        \n        print(\"[SeikoClaw] Serving visual plan on local bridge...\")\n        # Start server in background so CLI execution doesn't block permanently\n        subprocess.Popen(f\"{cmd_prefix} plan local serve --dir .agents/plans/plan --kind plan --open\", shell=True)\n        \n        # Read the URL\n        url_file = os.path.join(plan_dir, \".plan-url\")\n        import time\n        time.sleep(2)\n        if os.path.exists(url_file):\n            with open(url_file, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                url = f.read().strip()\n            print(f\"[SUCCESS] Visual Plan served successfully!\\nLocal Bridge URL: {url}\")\n        else:\n            print(\"[INFO] Bridge starting.
